focusedAudit.reason: 0.7.3 carries three first-run fixes (two cherry-picked from Beta, one stable-only CSS change), each with fail-before/pass-after proof; full suites and hosted CI run on the candidate.

items.text: Phones: query headers keep their title and view buttons readable, wrapping the buttons onto a second line instead of breaking words letter by letter (UI-MOBILE-QUERY-HEADER-WRAP).

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog row UI-MOBILE-QUERY-HEADER-WRAP; fail-before/pass-after recorded in the row notes.

docs.reason: Layout fix; the Guide does not describe query header wrapping.

website.reason: Stable patch release; the website describes Tine generally and needs no change for this item.

blog.reason: No editorial release gate (Martin 2026-10-13); release notes live in CHANGELOG.md and the GitHub release.
